prospective_boundary_rule: Only signal bars with closed-bar timestamp >= boundary are eligible. No pre-boundary trade outcome may enter this repair evaluation.
mechanism: Preserve the original Supertrend+EMA50 continuation eligibility but pay only at the onset of a qualifying eligibility state, not on every bar while the state persists.
payer: Directional persistence following the onset of a fully qualified trend-continuation state.
entry_event: long_eligible_t and not long_eligible_t_minus_1, or short_eligible_t and not short_eligible_t_minus_1
direction_rule: both; preserve original long/short eligibility and require an unambiguous single-side transition
invalidation: Fail if the frozen first-25 causal/placebo controls fail, or if prospective after-cost economics fail the existing survivor gate. Same identity may not be rescue-retuned.
exit_logic: Preserve original initial stop at 1.5*ATR14 from signal close and original 48-bar timeout; no new TP; no adverse add.
turnover_cost_budget: Preserve original verified round-trip cost authority and min_cost_budget_ratio=1.25; no cheaper-cost assumption.
falsification: The transition-only entry must independently clear the same fixed causal hard controls and after-cost gates; reduced trade count alone is not evidence.
why_distinct: The parent failed same-count random-entry causality despite strong direction inversion. This repair changes only the temporal ownership of entry from a persistent qualifying state to its first causal transition; all market-state thresholds and risk geometry remain frozen.
